_doc: Player-reported placements for objects/creatures the public server SQL gives a template (and loot) but NO spawn row -- the live realm has them, the repo does not. build-db adds a spawn point for each and records it in `reported_spawn`, so the page can say the marker is approximate and where the report came from. Each row: kind ('o' object / 'c' creature), entry, then EITHER `near` (a creature entry whose spawn points it borrows -- use when the report is 'next to boss X') OR explicit `map`,`x`,`y`,`z` (use when someone read real coordinates in game). `note` is shown verbatim on the page; `ref` is an https link to the evidence. A row whose entry gains a real spawn upstream is skipped with a build warning -- delete it then. Turtle-only. Hand-maintained; never guess a location to fill a gap.
